title: 12 Tribes
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
in today’s lesson 
you will hear about 12 tribes 
and the promised land

Who are the people in theses tribes?
The Israelites that left Egypt - over 2 million people!
Where did they come from?

Well let us start with Abraham!

Well Abraham 
had a son called
Isaac
and he had 2 sons
Esau and Jacob
Well Jacob had 12 sons 
one of them was Joseph
And the tribes are named after Jacobs sons
(They were Abrahams great grandsons)
Learn the 12 names in a song
So you see - God did keep his promise to Abraham - he did have many sons - grandsons:)

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for always keeping Your promises
Please help me to follow You
To love you and 
To trust and obey You
Amen
